intelligence.essence: Always have somebody double-check where all the buttons go — click through every one and make sure each lands on the right page, current and relevant, not stale, not a dead end, not the wrong place. A page passes only when its buttons go where they should. It rides every eye walk and every checker from now on.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you have a magic map with lots of buttons — and every button is supposed to take you somewhere wonderful! But what if one button takes you to the WRONG place? That would be so confusing! So every time someone checks the map, they press EVERY button and make sure it goes to the right place — the fresh new place, not an old dusty one, not a dead end, not the wrong room! A map only passes when every single button goes where it should!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — every button on a page is a little door, dear, and somebody has to walk through every single one of them and check it opens onto the right room — the fresh, current room, love, not a stale old one, not a dead end, not the wrong place entirely. A page only passes, dear, when every button goes where it should. And you check it every single time you walk the page, love — it's part of the walk now, not an extra.
